WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as avg_credit_amt,
    COUNT(*) as trans_count
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_count) as avg_trans_count
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  s1.account_id,
  s1.avg_credit_amt,
  s1.trans_count,
  CAST(s1.trans_count AS REAL) / s2.avg_trans_count as ratio
FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
WHERE s2.avg_trans_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
